verdict_note: One small budget-honesty defect, no build or test break found. The fix is a few lines, changes no output bytes and no test, so making it before the bundled run saves a re-run. If the lead accepts the overshoot, BUILD.

findings.what: Maximum/Minimum with preserve=roundness under-charges the byte budget. cost() charges plane_cost(area, BLUR_SAMPLE_BYTES, ...) = 32 B/px, but morphology() holds three planes at once on that path: pm (pm32, 16 B/px, borrowed, not moved, so alive until return), cur (16 B/px) and out (16 B/px) = 48 B/px. Admission passes a plane whose real peak is 1.5x the admitted bytes (plus the disc offsets, which are charged correctly).
findings.scenario: Minimum radius 2 roundness over a plane of max_bytes/32 pixels: admit() is Ok, peak allocation is about 1.5 x max_bytes, contrary to the module's 'refused against FilterLimits before allocating' claim (V4-02). Squareness is fine on planes (pm is moved into morph_square), but its line scratch is 40L+12 bytes against the charged 40L.
findings.fix: In morphology(), drop `out` and unpremultiply `cur` in place: `let mut cur = match ... ; for p in cur.iter_mut() { *p = finite(unpremultiply_in(UNIT, *p))?; } Ok(cur)`. Roundness peak becomes pm + cur = 32 B/px (matches the charge), squareness becomes 16 B/px plus scratch (charge then over-covers the 12-byte scratch slack). No output byte changes.

answers_to_aim.size: SMART_ENTRY_BYTES (render-cpu extended.rs:58, used :502-505) is only a budget charge multiplied by entry count; nothing is sized from it, so no compile error, no runtime refusal, no truncation. By reading the types: FilterKernel largest variant CustomConvolution = 100+4+4 = 108 B, no niche, u8 tag padded to align 4 -> 112 B. StackFilter: Kernel 112 (align 4) vs Liquify ~96 (LiquifyMesh Rect + 3 u32 + 2 Vec, align 8); Liquify and Filter fit after FilterKernel's tag niche -> 112 B (120 B if rustc does not niche-pack). SmartFilterEntryOp = StackFilter + Option<MaskInput> (~72) + f32 + bool -> about 192 B, against 128. At base it was already about 176 B (StackFilter 96), so the charge was already under; the lane adds about 16 B/entry, at most about 256 B over 16 entries. Not a finding.
answers_to_aim.kernel_maths_edges: Convolution: weights converted to f64 per tap, sum in binary64: i32::MAX weights x 25 taps x unit samples stay finite, no integer overflow; scale 0 refused in validate (Parameter); negative scale legal; centre alpha 0 short-circuits to [0;4], so no division by zero; any finite overflow of s/scale/a is clamped. Replicate border via saturating_sub/min(h-1) is correct for 1x1 and for planes smaller than the 5x5 kernel. Radius 0 is the identity for box, morphology, dust, surface, bilateral. NaN/inf samples refused by check() before any kernel; NaN/inf params refused by validate (finite checks on every f32). Huge emboss height: bilinear_add skips saturated/overflowed corners. Edge-preserving normaliser is at least 1 (self weight). unpremultiply_in clamps, so per-channel median/weights cannot leave the unit range. van Herk/Gil-Werman line pass traced: window = op(h[i], g[i+2r]), radius clamped to the line length with zero padding, correct for max and min under 'transparent beyond'.
answers_to_aim.bounded_work: Every kind calls admit() (validate, checked cost, bytes and work vs FilterLimits) before allocating. Unbounded radii (surface, bilateral) cost O(1) with checked u64; u32::MAX overflows to OverBudget. Roundness disc_len is O(r) <= 32001 iterations; the disc itself is only built after the bytes check (n x 16). Box blur over MAX_BOX_KERNEL_TAPS is OverBudget. 65536^2 planes are refused on bytes. Not cancellable inside a stack: SmartFilterStack::render has no token and run_smart checks cancel per job; declared in the DESCRIPTOR gaps. Work is counted in sample visits, so a bilateral entry (one exp per channel per tap) at max_work 2^34 runs far longer than a Gaussian entry at the same budget; this is the declared gap, not a defect.

No schema digest golden exists in the tree (git ls-tree found no committed schema file). Older build: an unknown filter_kind fails serde for the whole records entry; the viewer reports 'raster records not applied: <serde message>' (harness-view view/mod.rs:563-569) and renders without any records. That is a refusal, but a string, not a typed code, and it drops all raster records of the document, not only the new entry. This is existing forward-compatibility behaviour, outside this lane.
